title: A small Pentagon group dealt with the tall whites, whose base was like a foreign embassy

tellings.quote: The Pentagon had a tiny handful of people that knew they that interacted with them.

plain: In the 1960s, only a tiny handful of people at the Pentagon are said to have known about and dealt with the "tall whites." These were tall, pale beings who, the story goes, kept a base on the military ranges of Nevada that was treated like a foreign embassy. This comes from Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years near these beings while working on those ranges, and it would mean the US military kept quiet, diplomatic contact with visitors from elsewhere.
